stories.title: Gausman Cubs Debut Recap — 7 IP, Sharp, Fifth Straight Win
stories.angle: Gausman pitched 7 innings in his first Cubs start — 2 ER, 4H, 1BB, 4K on 96 pitches, the longest start of the season by any Cubs pitcher. Splitter was working. Cubs extended winning streak to five straight. No score per has_score=False insight. Lead with Gausman's line and what it means for the rotation.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Kevin Gausman looked every bit like the ace the Cubs paid for.

7 IP, 2 ER, 96 pitches — the longest Cubs start of the season. Splitter was filthy. Command was there all night.

Five straight wins. The rotation just got real.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: PCA MVP Race — Dead Even with Ohtani at -110 Odds
stories.angle: PCA and Ohtani both at -110 on FanDuel as of Aug 6; covers.com named PCA the new NL award favorite Aug 7. Season: .289 BA, 26 HR, 29 SB — on pace for second straight 30-30. Bold take: this race is real. No OPS cited (single-source). No game score.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong and Shohei Ohtani are dead even in the NL MVP race — -110 odds each.

PCA: .289 BA, 26 HR, 29 SB. On pace for a second straight 30-30 season. He's doing it with his legs, his arm, and his bat.

Ohtani is great. This isn't a layup anymore.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Bregman Hot Streak — .314 BA, 4 HR, 11 RBI in Last 12 Games
stories.angle: Bregman's last 12 games: .314 BA, 4 HR, 11 RBI — attacking the zone more, per Bleacher Nation Aug 7 analysis. August is historically his best month (career). The Cubs' lineup has two legitimate stars both peaking in August. Stat-backed, not hyperbole.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Alex Bregman is getting hot at exactly the right time.

Over his last 12 games: .314 BA, 4 HR, 11 RBI — and he's attacking the zone more aggressively than he has all season.

August is historically his best month. He looks locked in right now.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Wild Card Watch — Cubs 68-49, Cushion Growing
stories.angle: Cubs now 68-49 after the Gausman win. NL Wild Card No. 1 spot with Phillies and D-backs roughly six games back. Cardinals at 54-57 — a non-factor since June. Sharp rival jab folded into standings analysis.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Cubs are 68-49 and hold the No. 1 NL Wild Card spot.

Phillies and D-backs are roughly six games back. The Cardinals are 54-57 — a non-factor since June.

Chicago is playing October baseball. The only question is how deep they go.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Clay Holmes Debut Preview — 6:10 PM CT at Kauffman Stadium
stories.angle: Holmes making his first Cubs start tonight at 6:10 PM CT. Carried a 2.39 ERA in 9 Mets starts before fracturing his fibula. Activated from 60-day IL. Connects to Gausman's successful Friday debut — the Cubs' two big deadline starters taking the mound on back-to-back nights.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Clay Holmes makes his Cubs debut tonight at 6:10 PM CT at Kauffman Stadium.

Before his fibula injury, he carried a 2.39 ERA in 9 Mets starts. Activated from the 60-day IL for this.

Gausman delivered on Friday. Now it's Holmes's turn.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Cardinals Roast — 54-57 and Watching From the Couch
stories.angle: Cardinals are 54-57 and 15 games out. Cubs are in a Wild Card race. Sharp, witty jab anchored to real standings data. No engagement question — state the contrast and let it land.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
The Cardinals are 54-57 and 15 games out of first place in August.

Cubs fans are watching a Wild Card race unfold in real time. Cardinals fans are watching other teams play meaningful baseball.

Some summers are more fun than others.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Steele Back on Mound — Roster Moves as Cubs Manage Depth
stories.angle: Justin Steele threw off a mound Saturday — targeting a September bullpen role. Gavin Hollowell placed on 15-day IL (right shoulder inflammation), Antoine Kelly added to roster. Cubs actively managing pitching depth as stretch run intensifies.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Justin Steele threw off a mound Saturday — targeting a September bullpen role in his recovery.

Gavin Hollowell hit the 15-day IL (shoulder inflammation). Antoine Kelly called up to fill the spot.

Depth managed. Stretch run ready.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Holmes Pre-Game Hype — The Debut Is Here
stories.angle: Game in ~70 minutes at 6:10 PM CT. Holmes's moment. Punchy, emotionally charged. Connect to Gausman's Friday success — two consecutive nights of debut starts. Let the matchup and moment speak.

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text:
Clay Holmes. Kauffman Stadium. First pitch at 6:10 PM CT.

His first start in a Cubs uniform — working back from a fractured fibula, ready for the stretch run.

Gausman said yes on Friday.

Holmes answers tonight.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
